name: Can I stay in my home during a pre-foreclosure sale?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home during a pre-foreclosure sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, you can remain in your home during a pre-foreclosure sale until the transaction is complete and ownership is transferred to the new buyer. The specific timeline depends on how quickly a buyer is found and the closing process. It's a practical tradeoff, as staying in the home allows for continued residency but requires you to keep the property show-ready for potential buyers. Managing this balance can be critical in locations such as Aventura or Sunny Isles Beach, where quick turnovers are common.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can typically stay in your home during a pre-foreclosure sale until it closes, but you must keep it ready for showings.
